results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary: FOMC held rates at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026. 8-4 vote split. Inflation elevated partly due to global energy prices from Iran war. Markets pricing in no cuts through 2027.
